a: A trie stores strings by shared prefixes for fast prefix queries.
Union-Find tracks disjoint sets with near-constant operations.
Segment trees answer range queries and updates efficiently.
Fenwick trees (BIT) support prefix sums and point updates.
Topological sort orders tasks with prerequisites (DAGs).
Floyd-Warshall finds all-pairs shortest paths in O(V³).
0/1 knapsack is a classic DP for capacity-constrained selection.
Longest Common Subsequence is solved with DP on two sequences.
Edit distance counts minimum inserts/deletes/replaces between strings.
Deque-based sliding window can track range maximums in linear time.
